_about: How the benchmark tools plan and run each board. 'class_defaults' gives minutes per test and what a class needs beyond the board on USB, for boards with no recipe yet. 'boards' holds the boards whose steps are scripted: the probe, what a run erases, how to back up and restore, and each step (commands run from 'cwd', the rows it writes, minutes measured on our bench, what to expect). Commands are the board's existing scripts; a step that needs a wire says so in 'needs'. Read by tools/benchmark/plan.py and tools/benchmark/backup.py.

analog.needs: uart_max_clean and adc_dac_error need one jumper wire (the board's arrival plan or RUN-THE-TESTS page shows where)

radio.needs: a second radio or a hub (Home Assistant, a second board)

power.needs: a meter: EnergyTrace on an XDS110-ET probe, or a bench meter in the 3V3 shunt

agent.needs: run with the ai-cost-run skill (six fresh agents)

mspm0l1306.erases: main flash, 64 kB at 0x00000000. NONMAIN (boot configuration) is never written.

tool.route_why: with a route in data/routes.json, backup.py runs OpenOCD from Python (tools/frl/target.py), so a reader's backup works on macOS, Linux and Windows; ocd.sh stays for the bench
tool.why: DSLite's memory map refuses reads at 0x0000FFF8 on this board (2026-10-08); OpenOCD dump_image reads all 64 kB

mspm0l1306.machine_note: Scripts call tools at fixed macOS paths at the top of each build.sh and run.sh and in mspm0l1306/tools/ocd.sh; change those lines on another machine.

steps.expect: build about 3.3 s, flash about 0.6 s, the LED blinks at the changed rate
steps.proof: the person at the board sees the changed rate, or a pin read

steps.expect: Correct operation validated, Total ticks 408864304, 78.27 iterations per second
11 words from struct tm; decode with the field list in main.c (toggle 1.0 to 1.12 cycles, interrupt entry 25 to 28)
